text:
maria-ops: Heads up — planning a release that touches runtime, router, and api. Proposed window Tue 03:00 UTC. Need a short preflight: runtime v2.4.0 (kv-cache tweak), router v1.9.0, api v3.1. Can we coordinate pins/fallbacks?

deploy-bot: Scheduled wave 'runtime:v2.4.0' to eng cluster at 2026-03-24T03:00:00Z. Canary target: 5% traffic in us-west. Actions: /pin, /canary. :robot_face:

kevin-runtime: FYI v2.4 changes kernel kv prefix behavior — router must pass the `x-prefix-key` header or we'll hit 500s on some paths. Router change is backward-compatible if it normalizes headers, but if not we should pin router in sensitive regions.

sasha-console: Console PR adds header normalization and a translation layer. It landed but needs the api to accept the new name. Can ship console in the window but gate via rollout policy. Propose: pin router in EU to current stable (1.8.x) and allow progressive unpin in US if tests pass.

jonathan-api: API will accept both header formats for 48h behind feature-flag `accept-new-prefix` (default off). I'll deploy canary of api v3.1 with the flag off, flip to on once runtime canary looks healthy.

maria-ops: Proposed execution plan:
1) Deploy console + api canaries (flag off).
2) Deploy runtime v2.4 canary at 5% (us-west).
3) Monitor for 30m -> ramp 25% -> 100% if healthy.
4) Router: pin eu to 1.8.9 until api flag at >=25% in eu.

Rollback & guardrails:
- 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 15m => immediate rollback.
- p50 latency increase > 35% over baseline => pause and investigate.
- KV eviction alarm => stop and rollback runtime to v2.3.7.

kevin-runtime: Add a runtime alarm for KV miss/eviction spikes. If triggered, automated rollback to v2.3.7 and notify the thread.

deploy-bot: Pinned router 'eu' to 1.8.9 in config. Command executed: `/pin router eu 1.8.9` — success.

sasha-console: I'll add a console banner + release note snippet explaining the temporary EU pin and graceful degradation behavior. Also adding contact info for on-call.

jonathan-api: I'll coordinate the flag toggles and push the api canary now. Tagging @kevin-runtime for the perf matrix (kv hit/miss, latency).

lin-sre: I'll run synthetics across eu->us cross-region paths and keep an eye on the trace sampling. Standby for canary window.

maria-ops: Go/no-go checkpoint at T+40m after canary ramp to 5% -> 25%. If rollback needed: runtime revert to v2.3.7 and then unpin router after tests clear. Everyone acknowledge with :thumbsup:

kevin-runtime: :thumbsup:

sasha-console: ✅

jonathan-api: 👍

lin-sre: watching the dashboards now

deploy-bot: Rollout started at 2026-03-24T03:00:00Z (canary 5%). Will post status updates automatically.
